record.name: Help Scout
record.one_liner: Help Scout is a customer service platform that provides shared inboxes, knowledge bases, and live chat for support teams.
record.access_note: API access is available on paid plans (Standard, Plus, Pro) and is not included on the Free plan.
record.api_note: The Mailbox API and Docs API cover conversations, customers, mailboxes, reporting, and knowledge base articles.
record.blocker_note: API access requires a paid subscription plan (Standard or higher) as free accounts lack API access.
